text:
maria: Seeing a spike of 502/504s from hosted-api.edge on EU region starting ~09:12UTC. Affected customers hitting embeddings/batch endpoint. 20% error rate, errors correlate with large concurrent batches (>=8k tokens).

devon: putting initial traces here — example trace id 02af9c3e, request path /v1/embeddings/batch. Envoy upstream log shows `upstream request timeout` then 502 at edge. Nginx at ingress reports 504 for some streams.

ashwin: can you paste the curl repro? I want a quick local repro to confirm.

maria: here's a minimal repro we used from a customer (sanitized):

```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"rw-embed-large-v1\",\"inputs\":[\"...large payload...\"],\"batch_size\":32}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch
```

maria: on the edge logs I see repeated `HTTP/2 stream error: REFUSED_STREAM` and `GRPC_STATUS=14` on some upstreams.

sophie: saw a similar pattern earlier — h2 connection windowing + long-lived auth backend calls can exhaust keepalive pools. Metrics show h2 outstanding streams peaking at 1200 on the auth pool for the EU cluster.

support-ops: alert triggered: edge-gateway-502-504-spike (severity: high) — incident channel created.

devon: tcpdump snippet from edge host (filtered to dst port 8443), lots of RSTs after 120s of stalled payloads. Suspect upstream idle timeout mismatch between edge and backend: edge uses 60s, backend 120s.

ashwin: quick mitigation — we can temporarily increase edge upstream timeout to 180s for the cluster and enable proxy-buffering off for the embeddings route. Rolling change to gate by region. Any objections?

maria: do it. Also throttle per-tenant concurrency to 4 for embeddings for hosted customers — pushing temp rate-limit policy.

sophie: I'll push a canary adjust on the EU pods now. Also adding an Envoy cluster-level circuit-breaker: max_requests 50000 -> 15000 for the auth backend to prevent pool exhaustion.

edge-bot: config-change: route: /v1/embeddings/batch — timeout set to 180000ms by sophie (canary: 5%).

maria: after canary we saw errors drop to ~3% in EU. Customer reported restoration. Keeping watch for 30m.

devon: follow-ups: (1) run a load-test with realistic batch sizes to reproduce; (2) audit auth microservice keepalive and connection reuse; (3) add per-tenant concurrency controls in the control plane.

ashwin: logging note — we should enrich upstream logs with request_size and batch_count for embeddings so we can quickly filter heavy requests.

support-ops: created ticket SUP-7213, assigned to eng-infra and eng-runtime. ETA for full rollout of fixes: 48 hours (post load testing and monitoring guardrails).

maria: customer-facing message drafted: apologize, explain transient congestion due to large batch embeddings, steps taken (timeouts increased, throttles added, monitoring), offer account credits if SLA impacted. Waiting on approvals.

sophie: long-term ideas: (a) autoscale dedicated pool for embeddings in hosted; (b) shard auth cache per-tenant to reduce cross-tenant cold misses; (c) introduce streaming-friendly endpoint for huge batches to avoid long blocking requests.

devon: adding to roadmap. Closing slack thread once incident postmortem attached.

maria: thanks everyone, marking as resolved for now. Will post postmortem in incidents channel tomorrow.
